players.product: Optical thin-film deposition equipment for data-center optical transceivers: vapor deposition (OTFC-1300 / SPOC-1300) for AR/HR and WDM/TFF filter films on lasers, optical filters and modules; sputtering (OWLS-1800 / SPOC-S-1200) for SiPh PIC, TFLN and optical-engine films; ALD and etching systems

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (January - December 2025): net sales JPY 33,861 million (up 4.5%), operating income JPY 3,334 million (down 49.2%), ordinary income JPY 3,202 million (down 60.9%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 2,959 million (down 53.4%). Management states sales rose on strong equipment sales for automotive displays and cameras in the optics domain, for optical components including optical communications, and for opto-electronics in the semiconductor-optics domain; operating income fell on lower sales of high-margin ALD equipment and inventory valuation losses, with the cost-of-sales ratio up 11.0 points to 66.2%; ordinary income was also hit by a foreign-exchange loss of JPY 315 million from the stronger yen and an equity-method investment loss of JPY 127 million.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 33,861 million (+4.5%); operating income JPY 3,334 million (-49.2%); cost-of-sales ratio 66.2%

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 film-deposition equipment business (single segment): orders received JPY 40,993,117 thousand (126.7% of the prior year) and order backlog at year end JPY 31,290,456 thousand (129.5% of the prior year); production JPY 19,318,636 thousand at manufacturing cost (140.1% of the prior year).
quarterly_data.figure: orders JPY 40,993,117 thousand (126.7%); backlog JPY 31,290,456 thousand (129.5%); production JPY 19,318,636 thousand (140.1%)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 revenue by field: optics JPY 26,270,832 thousand (prior year JPY 28,523,023 thousand), semiconductor-optics convergence JPY 3,248,911 thousand (prior year JPY 889,563 thousand), other JPY 4,341,541 thousand (prior year JPY 2,993,250 thousand); total JPY 33,861,286 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor-optics convergence JPY 3,248,911 thousand (FY2024 JPY 889,563 thousand); optics JPY 26,270,832 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 net sales by customer location: China JPY 29,090,424 thousand, Taiwan JPY 1,692,728 thousand, Vietnam JPY 1,423,949 thousand, Japan JPY 1,100,726 thousand, other JPY 553,457 thousand (total JPY 33,861,286 thousand). The company states its business is highly dependent on the Greater China market, so it is setting up head-office functions in both Japan and China so each region can operate independently, building equipment-installation support and parts service in Vietnam for deposition makers that moved there, and developing a base in India to establish a service system there.
quarterly_data.figure: China JPY 29,090,424 thousand of JPY 33,861,286 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Zhejiang Sunny Optics Co., Ltd. (film-deposition equipment business): JPY 3,711,514 thousand, 11.5% of FY2024 net sales; in FY2025 no customer accounted for 10% or more of net sales, so none is listed.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 3,711,514 thousand; 11.5% of FY2024 net sales

quarterly_data.signal: Management outlook (as of the FY2025 year end): smartphone shipments are forecast to fall year on year on memory shortages caused by AI-server demand and rising component prices, but the company expects demand to grow in high-end models (AI-equipped and foldable models, more advanced cameras); automotive deposition demand is expected to keep growing with autonomous driving; in optical communications the generative-AI / data-center market is expanding rapidly, optical connections between semiconductor chips and between data centers are indispensable, and the company expects high growth to continue. It positions semiconductor optics and electronic devices as growth pillars after optics, and its mid-to-long-term targets are ROE of 10% or more and a silicon photonics (opto-electronic convergence) share of sales of 20% or more.
quarterly_data.figure: silicon photonics share of sales target 20% or more; ROE 10% or more

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 capital expenditure JPY 698 million; as of the year end the company had no significant new facilities or disposals planned. Main facilities: the Tsurugashima, Saitama head office (R&D and production), the Shanghai plants of Optorun Shanghai (365 employees) and Optorun Semiconductor Technology (Shanghai) (96 employees), and the Taiwan plant in Miaoli County. FY2025 R&D expenses JPY 3,801 million, covering deposition equipment and processes for smartphone camera modules, housings and touch panels and automotive sensors, cameras and displays (optics), sensors, cameras and displays for AR/VR head-mounted displays and smart glasses (semiconductor optics), and all-solid-state batteries and communication devices (electronic devices).
quarterly_data.figure: capex JPY 698 million; R&D JPY 3,801 million

quarterly_data.signal: Material contract: on February 14, 2025 Optorun signed a capital and business alliance with AI Mechatec (a maker of flat-panel-display and semiconductor-package manufacturing equipment, now an equity-method affiliate, 17.6% voting rights) to strengthen the nanoimprint lithography business run through Nanolithotics, the joint venture the two set up on July 3, 2023 (now a consolidated subsidiary), and to collaborate by combining their technologies.
